scope: Prewarmed synthetic Store snapshots and real chat/file View headless frame layout. No Host, native window, GPU presentation, system clipboard or model requests.
fixtureCorrection: The first chat viewport measurement constructed a zero-revision ViewState, selecting the compatibility fallback. Only that benchmark was corrected to retain an immutable Store history revision and rerun; the original log remains. Use the chat-revision log for production revision-cache conclusions.
conclusions: File View steady frames retain a bounded viewport through 100000 lines; measured frame work and allocations do not grow with source size in this fixture.
Chat View with a valid unchanged history revision retains 6 visible rows and 230 allocations per frame; time rises from 0.169 to 0.350 ms across 500 to 8000 rows rather than proportional 16x growth.

Store streaming snapshot work remains history-size dependent: at 7801 messages the frame snapshot path costs 7.579 ms and 21.431 MB per changed snapshot. Viewport virtualization alone does not establish full streaming performance.

These are average microbenchmark costs, not input-to-visible p95/p99, first-frame latency or overall application memory. Cold line parsing is outside the timed window. The original snapshot fixture excludes every fortieth nominal event as a trajectory boundary; actual message counts are recorded explicitly.
cleanup: Both runs used with-build-workspace shared caches and reclaimed their own temporary workspaces.
